-- Author: @toskua
module

public import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.Algebra

/-!
# Continuous functions on a disjoint union as a product of semirings

The existing bundled `ContinuousMap.sigmaEquiv` retains all original
restriction and recombination maps. Its inverse preserves semiring
operations pointwise, so it is the actual function-ring equivalence.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u v w

namespace ContinuousMap

variable {ι : Type w} (X : ι → Type u) (R : Type v)
variable [∀ i, TopologicalSpace (X i)] [TopologicalSpace R]
variable [Semiring R] [IsTopologicalSemiring R]

/-- The same bundled sigma-function equivalence, with its actual
restrictions and recombination maps, as a semiring equivalence. -/
def sigmaRingEquiv : C((Σ i, X i), R) ≃+* ∀ i, C(X i, R) where
  toEquiv := (sigmaEquiv R X).symm
  map_mul' _ _ := rfl
  map_add' _ _ := rfl

/-- Every coordinate is the actual original restriction along `Sigma.mk`. -/
@[simp]
theorem sigmaRingEquiv_apply (f : C((Σ i, X i), R)) (i : ι) (x : X i) :
    sigmaRingEquiv X R f i x = f ⟨i, x⟩ := rfl

/-- The inverse is the original bundled sigma recombination map. -/
@[simp]
theorem sigmaRingEquiv_symm_apply (f : ∀ i, C(X i, R)) (i : ι) (x : X i) :
    (sigmaRingEquiv X R).symm f ⟨i, x⟩ = f i x := rfl

end ContinuousMap

-- Author: @toskua
module

public import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.Algebra
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Ring.Equiv

/-!
# The coefficient ring of a singleton continuous-function space

For a space with a unique point, evaluation of the original continuous
functions is a bijective ring homomorphism. Its inverse ring equivalence
sends a coefficient to the actual constant function. The coefficients can
form an associative semiring, in a universe independent of the source space.

The generic evaluation is the existing function evaluation composed with
the existing continuous-function inclusion. For commutative coefficients,
the complete maps agree with the stock `evalAlgHom` and `C` maps.
-/

public section

noncomputable section

universe uX uR uS

namespace ContinuousMap

section Semiring

variable (X : Type uX) (R : Type uR) [Unique X] [TopologicalSpace X]
  [Semiring R] [TopologicalSpace R] [IsTopologicalSemiring R]

private theorem singletonEvaluation_bijective :
    Function.Bijective
      ((Pi.evalRingHom (fun _ : X => R) (default : X)).comp
        (coeFnRingHom : C(X, R) →+* (X → R))) := by
  constructor
  · intro f g h
    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro x
    change f (default : X) = g (default : X) at h
    exact (congrArg f (Subsingleton.elim x (default : X))).trans
      (h.trans (congrArg g (Subsingleton.elim (default : X) x)))
  · intro r
    exact ⟨ContinuousMap.const X r, rfl⟩

/-- The original coefficient ring and singleton continuous-function ring,
with the actual constant function as forward map and evaluation as inverse. -/
def constRingEquiv : R ≃+* C(X, R) :=
  (RingEquiv.ofBijective
    ((Pi.evalRingHom (fun _ : X => R) (default : X)).comp
      (coeFnRingHom : C(X, R) →+* (X → R)))
    (singletonEvaluation_bijective X R)).symm

/-- The actual inverse is evaluation at the original unique point. -/
@[simp]
theorem constRingEquiv_symm_apply (f : C(X, R)) :
    (constRingEquiv X R).symm f = f (default : X) := by
  change RingEquiv.ofBijective _ (singletonEvaluation_bijective X R) f = _
  exact RingEquiv.ofBijective_apply _ _ f

/-- The complete forward value is the original constant continuous function. -/
@[simp]
theorem constRingEquiv_apply (r : R) :
    constRingEquiv X R r = ContinuousMap.const X r := by
  apply (constRingEquiv X R).symm.injective
  rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply, constRingEquiv_symm_apply]
  rfl

/-- The whole forward function is the existing constant-function constructor. -/
theorem coe_constRingEquiv :
    (constRingEquiv X R : R → C(X, R)) = ContinuousMap.const X := by
  funext r
  exact constRingEquiv_apply X R r

/-- The whole inverse ring homomorphism is the original stock evaluation composite. -/
theorem constRingEquiv_symm_toRingHom :
    (constRingEquiv X R).symm.toRingHom =
      (Pi.evalRingHom (fun _ : X => R) (default : X)).comp
        (coeFnRingHom : C(X, R) →+* (X → R)) := by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro f
  exact constRingEquiv_symm_apply X R f

end Semiring

section Coefficients

variable (X : Type uX) [Unique X] [TopologicalSpace X]
  {R : Type uR} {S : Type uS} [Semiring R] [Semiring S]
  [TopologicalSpace R] [TopologicalSpace S] [IsTopologicalSemiring R] [IsTopologicalSemiring S]

/-- The complete singleton coefficient equivalences commute with the original
continuous postcomposition ring homomorphism, in independent ring universes. -/
theorem constRingEquiv_compLeftContinuous (f : R →+* S) (hf : Continuous f) :
    (f.compLeftContinuous X hf).comp (constRingEquiv X R).toRingHom =
      (constRingEquiv X S).toRingHom.comp f := by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro x
  change f ((constRingEquiv X R r) x) = (constRingEquiv X S (f r)) x
  simp only [constRingEquiv_apply, const_apply]

end Coefficients

section Commutative

variable (X : Type uX) (R : Type uR) [Unique X] [TopologicalSpace X]
  [CommSemiring R] [TopologicalSpace R] [IsTopologicalSemiring R]

/-- For commutative coefficients the whole forward map is the stock constant ring homomorphism. -/
theorem constRingEquiv_toRingHom :
    (constRingEquiv X R).toRingHom = ContinuousMap.C (α := X) (R := R) (A := R) := by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro x
  change (constRingEquiv X R r) x = (ContinuousMap.C r) x
  rw [constRingEquiv_apply, const_apply, C_apply]
  rfl

/-- For commutative coefficients the whole inverse is the stock evaluation algebra homomorphism. -/
theorem constRingEquiv_symm_toEvalAlgHom :
    (constRingEquiv X R).symm.toRingHom =
      (ContinuousMap.evalAlgHom R R (default : X)).toRingHom := by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro f
  exact constRingEquiv_symm_apply X R f

end Commutative

end ContinuousMap

-- Author: @toskua
module

public import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.Algebra
public import Mathlib.Topology.Constructions.SumProd
public import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Functor

/-!
# Continuous functions on a sum as a product of semirings

The original sum-arrow equivalence restricts to continuous functions.
Restriction along the two inclusions and the actual `Sum.elim` map are
inverse, and all semiring operations remain pointwise.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

universe uX uY v

namespace ContinuousMap

variable (X : Type uX) (Y : Type uY) (R : Type v)
variable [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [TopologicalSpace R]
variable [Semiring R] [IsTopologicalSemiring R]

/-- Restriction and the original sum eliminator identify continuous
functions on a disjoint sum with the product of the original function semirings. -/
def sumRingEquiv : C(X ⊕ Y, R) ≃+* C(X, R) × C(Y, R) where
  toFun f :=
    (⟨fun x => f (Sum.inl x), f.continuous.comp continuous_inl⟩,
     ⟨fun y => f (Sum.inr y), f.continuous.comp continuous_inr⟩)
  invFun p := ⟨Sum.elim p.1 p.2, p.1.continuous.sumElim p.2.continuous⟩
  left_inv f := by
    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro z
    exact congrFun ((Equiv.sumArrowEquivProdArrow X Y R).left_inv f) z
  right_inv p := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · apply ContinuousMap.ext
      intro x
      rfl
    · apply ContinuousMap.ext
      intro y
      rfl
  map_mul' f g := by
    apply Prod.ext <;> apply ContinuousMap.ext <;> intro z <;> rfl
  map_add' f g := by
    apply Prod.ext <;> apply ContinuousMap.ext <;> intro z <;> rfl

/-- The first component is actual restriction to the left summand. -/
@[simp]
theorem sumRingEquiv_fst_apply (f : C(X ⊕ Y, R)) (x : X) :
    (sumRingEquiv X Y R f).1 x = f (Sum.inl x) := rfl

/-- The second component is actual restriction to the right summand. -/
@[simp]
theorem sumRingEquiv_snd_apply (f : C(X ⊕ Y, R)) (y : Y) :
    (sumRingEquiv X Y R f).2 y = f (Sum.inr y) := rfl

/-- The inverse retains the original left coefficient on the left summand. -/
@[simp]
theorem sumRingEquiv_symm_inl (p : C(X, R) × C(Y, R)) (x : X) :
    (sumRingEquiv X Y R).symm p (Sum.inl x) = p.1 x := rfl

/-- The inverse retains the original right coefficient on the right summand. -/
@[simp]
theorem sumRingEquiv_symm_inr (p : C(X, R) × C(Y, R)) (y : Y) :
    (sumRingEquiv X Y R).symm p (Sum.inr y) = p.2 y := rfl

end ContinuousMap

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Topology.ContinuousMap.ZeroAtInfty.ExtendByZero

/-!
# Restriction of a compact-space function zero outside a subspace

A continuous function on a compact space that vanishes outside a subspace
restricts to a function vanishing at infinity on that subspace. Its compact
level sets lie in the subspace. For an open subspace of a Hausdorff space,
restriction and the actual zero extension are inverse coordinate maps.

This strict construction is needed for the actual interval cone/suspension
ports; no boundary equivalence theorem or output model is selected.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open Filter Set Topology
open scoped ZeroAtInfty

namespace ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap

universe uX uY

variable {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X]
variable {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace Y] [Zero Y]

/-- Restrict the actual compact-space function to the given subspace.
Zero values outside the subspace force the restricted function to vanish
at infinity, without an additional openness or metric hypothesis. -/
def restrictZeroOutside (s : Set X) (f : C(X, Y))
    (hzero : ∀ x : X, x ∉ s → f x = 0) : C₀(s, Y) where
  toFun x := f x
  continuous_toFun := f.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val
  zero_at_infty' := by
    apply Filter.tendsto_def.2
    intro V hV
    obtain ⟨U, hUV, hU, h0U⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.1 hV
    let K : Set X := f ⁻¹' Uᶜ
    have hK : IsCompact K := (hU.isClosed_compl.preimage f.continuous).isCompact
    have hKs : K ⊆ s := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra hxs
      have hfx : f x = 0 := hzero x hxs
      exact hx (hfx.symm ▸ h0U)
    have hKr : K ⊆ Set.range (Subtype.val : s → X) := by
      intro x hx
      exact ⟨⟨x, hKs hx⟩, rfl⟩
    have hKsub : IsCompact ((Subtype.val : s → X) ⁻¹' K) :=
      IsEmbedding.subtypeVal.isInducing.isCompact_preimage' hK hKr
    apply Filter.mem_cocompact.2
    refine ⟨(Subtype.val : s → X) ⁻¹' K, hKsub, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    apply hUV
    by_contra hxU
    exact hx hxU

/-- Restriction preserves every original point of the subspace. -/
@[simp]
theorem restrictZeroOutside_apply (s : Set X) (f : C(X, Y))
    (hzero : ∀ x : X, x ∉ s → f x = 0) (x : s) :
    restrictZeroOutside s f hzero x = f x := rfl

section OpenSubspace

variable [T2Space X] {s : Set X}

/-- Zero extension after restriction recovers the original compact-space function. -/
theorem extendByZero_restrictZeroOutside (hs : IsOpen s) (f : C(X, Y))
    (hzero : ∀ x : X, x ∉ s → f x = 0) :
    extendByZero hs (restrictZeroOutside s f hzero) = f := by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ s
  · exact extendByZero_apply hs (restrictZeroOutside s f hzero) ⟨x, hx⟩
  · exact (extendByZero_apply_of_not_mem hs _ hx).trans (hzero x hx).symm

/-- Restriction of the actual zero extension recovers the original C0 function. -/
theorem restrictZeroOutside_extendByZero (hs : IsOpen s) (f : C₀(s, Y)) :
    restrictZeroOutside s (extendByZero hs f)
      (fun _x hx => extendByZero_apply_of_not_mem hs f hx) = f := by
  apply ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.ext
  intro x
  exact extendByZero_apply hs f x

end OpenSubspace
end ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Topology.ContinuousMap.ZeroAtInfty.PointCutoff
public import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
public import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum

/-!
# Actual compact-support cutoffs and density in the original scalar C0 algebra

These strict prerequisites serve the actual continuous-multiplier constructor
in Lance OCR3246. The original locally compact Hausdorff X is retained.
Compact support is an actual proved property of the chosen C0 function.
No normal-space, bounded-function or nonempty-space premise is added.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Set Filter
open scoped Topology ZeroAtInfty

namespace ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap
universe uX
variable {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X] [LocallyCompactSpace X] [T2Space X]

/-- Retain the actual compact support, one-on-K values and original pointwise norm bound. -/
theorem exists_compact_one_on {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ φ : C₀(X, ℂ), HasCompactSupport φ ∧ EqOn φ 1 K ∧ ∀ x : X, ‖φ x‖ ≤ 1 := by
  obtain ⟨φ, hsupport, hone, _hnorm, hpoint⟩ :=
    exists_compact_one_on_of_regularSpace hK
  exact ⟨φ, hsupport, hone, hpoint⟩

/-- At every original point there is a genuine compact-support test function equal to one. -/
theorem exists_compact_point_cutoff (x : X) :
    ∃ φ : C₀(X, ℂ), HasCompactSupport φ ∧ φ x = 1 ∧ ∀ y : X, ‖φ y‖ ≤ 1 := by
  exact ⟨pointCutoff x, pointCutoff_hasCompactSupport x, pointCutoff_apply x,
    fun y => pointCutoff_norm_apply_le x y⟩

/-- Actual compact-support scalar C0 functions are dense for the original C0 norm. -/
theorem dense_hasCompactSupport : Dense {g : C₀(X, ℂ) | HasCompactSupport g} := by
  rw [Metric.dense_iff]
  intro h ε hε
  have hquarter : 0 < ε / 4 := div_pos hε (by norm_num)
  have hsmall : {x : X | ‖h x‖ < ε / 4} ∈ cocompact X := by
    rw [← Filter.eventually_iff]
    have hdist := (Metric.tendsto_nhds.1 (zero_at_infty h)) (ε / 4) hquarter
    exact hdist.mono fun x hx => by
      rwa [dist_zero_right] at hx
  obtain ⟨K, hK, houtside⟩ := Filter.mem_cocompact.1 hsmall
  obtain ⟨φ, hφsupport, hφone, hφnorm⟩ := exists_compact_one_on hK
  let g : C₀(X, ℂ) := φ * h
  have hgsupport : HasCompactSupport (g : X → ℂ) := hφsupport.mul_right
  have hnorm : ‖g - h‖ ≤ ε / 2 := by
    rw [← norm_toBCF_eq_norm (f := g - h)]
    apply (BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_le (by linarith : 0 ≤ ε / 2)).2
    intro x
    change ‖g x - h x‖ ≤ ε / 2
    by_cases hx : x ∈ K
    · have hφx : φ x = 1 := hφone hx
      change ‖φ x * h x - h x‖ ≤ ε / 2
      rw [hφx, one_mul, sub_self, norm_zero]
      linarith
    · have hhx : ‖h x‖ < ε / 4 := houtside hx
      have hgx : ‖g x‖ ≤ ‖h x‖ := by
        change ‖φ x * h x‖ ≤ ‖h x‖
        calc
          ‖φ x * h x‖ = ‖φ x‖ * ‖h x‖ := norm_mul _ _
          _ ≤ 1 * ‖h x‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hφnorm x) (norm_nonneg _)
          _ = ‖h x‖ := one_mul _
      calc
        ‖g x - h x‖ ≤ ‖g x‖ + ‖h x‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ ε / 2 := by linarith
  refine ⟨g, ?_, hgsupport⟩
  change dist g h < ε
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt hnorm (by linarith)

end ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap

/-
Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.ZeroAtInfty

/-!
# Extension by zero from an open subspace

A continuous function vanishing at infinity on an open subspace of a
Hausdorff space extends continuously by zero. The compact sets supplied by
the actual C0 condition control every boundary point. No metric, norm,
local compactness or algebra structure is required.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter Set Topology
open scoped ZeroAtInfty

noncomputable section

namespace ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap

universe uX uY

variable {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
variable {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace Y] [Zero Y]
variable {s : Set X}

private theorem continuous_extendByZero (hs : IsOpen s) (f : C₀(s, Y)) :
    Continuous (Function.extend (Subtype.val : s → X) f (0 : X → Y)) := by
  classical
  let g : X → Y := Function.extend (Subtype.val : s → X) f (0 : X → Y)
  have hzero (y : X) (hy : y ∉ s) : g y = 0 := by
    exact Function.extend_apply' (f := (Subtype.val : s → X))
      f (0 : X → Y) y (by
        rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
        exact hy (hz ▸ z.property))
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ s
  · let z : s := ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hcomp : ContinuousAt (g ∘ (Subtype.val : s → X)) z := by
      change ContinuousAt (fun y : s => g y) z
      have heq : (fun y : s => g y) = (f : s → Y) := by
        funext y
        exact Subtype.val_injective.extend_apply f (0 : X → Y) y
      rw [heq]
      exact f.continuous_toFun.continuousAt
    exact (hs.isOpenEmbedding_subtypeVal.continuousAt_iff (g := g) (x := z)).mp hcomp
  · change Tendsto g (𝓝 x) (𝓝 (g x))
    rw [hzero x hx]
    refine Filter.tendsto_def.2 ?_
    intro V hV
    have hfV : f ⁻¹' V ∈ cocompact s := (zero_at_infty f) hV
    obtain ⟨K, hK, hKV⟩ := Filter.mem_cocompact.mp hfV
    have hclosed : IsClosed ((Subtype.val : s → X) '' K) :=
      (hK.image continuous_subtype_val).isClosed
    have hxK : x ∉ (Subtype.val : s → X) '' K := by
      rintro ⟨z, _, hz⟩
      exact hx (hz ▸ z.property)
    refine Filter.mem_of_superset (hclosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hxK) ?_
    intro y hy
    change g y ∈ V
    by_cases hys : y ∈ s
    · have hyK : (⟨y, hys⟩ : s) ∉ K := by
        intro hyK
        exact hy ⟨⟨y, hys⟩, hyK, rfl⟩
      have hval : g y = f ⟨y, hys⟩ :=
        Subtype.val_injective.extend_apply f (0 : X → Y) ⟨y, hys⟩
      rw [hval]
      exact hKV hyK
    · rw [hzero y hys]
      exact mem_of_mem_nhds hV

/-- The literal zero extension of a C0 function on an open subspace. -/
@[no_expose]
def extendByZero (hs : IsOpen s) (f : C₀(s, Y)) : C(X, Y) where
  toFun := Function.extend (Subtype.val : s → X) f (0 : X → Y)
  continuous_toFun := continuous_extendByZero hs f

/-- The extension has exactly the original values on the open subspace. -/
@[simp]
theorem extendByZero_apply (hs : IsOpen s) (f : C₀(s, Y)) (x : s) :
    extendByZero hs f (x : X) = f x := by
  change Function.extend (Subtype.val : s → X) f (0 : X → Y) (x : X) = f x
  exact Subtype.val_injective.extend_apply f (0 : X → Y) x

/-- Every point outside the open subspace, including its boundary, has value zero. -/
@[simp]
theorem extendByZero_apply_of_not_mem (hs : IsOpen s) (f : C₀(s, Y))
    {x : X} (hx : x ∉ s) : extendByZero hs f x = 0 := by
  change Function.extend (Subtype.val : s → X) f (0 : X → Y) x = 0
  exact Function.extend_apply' (f := (Subtype.val : s → X))
    f (0 : X → Y) x (by
      rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
      exact hx (hz ▸ z.property))

end ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap

/-
Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.ZeroAtInfty
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Basic
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Real.Sqrt

/-!
# The vanishing coordinate on a bounded half-open real interval

The actual coordinate on (0,b] tends to zero along the cocompact filter.
Large-coordinate sets have compact real images [epsilon,b]. Its norm is
max b 0, so endpoints b<=0 give the zero map on the empty domain. The local
square-root coordinate supplies the genuine star-square witness, without an
order dictionary, chosen positive model or universal-property assumption.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Set Filter
open scoped ZeroAtInfty

noncomputable section

namespace ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap

/-- The literal complex coordinate on (0,b], including empty nonpositive intervals. -/
def iocCoordinate (b : ℝ) : C₀(Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) b, ℂ) where
  toFun x := ((x : ℝ) : ℂ)
  continuous_toFun := Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_subtype_val
  zero_at_infty' := by
    apply Metric.tendsto_nhds.mpr
    intro epsilon hepsilon
    let K : Set (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) b) := {x | epsilon ≤ (x : ℝ)}
    have hK : IsCompact K := by
      apply Subtype.isCompact_iff.mpr
      have himage : Subtype.val '' K = Set.Icc epsilon b := by
        ext x
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
          exact ⟨hy, y.property.2⟩
        · intro hx
          exact ⟨⟨x, ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hepsilon hx.1, hx.2⟩⟩, hx.1, rfl⟩
      rw [himage]
      exact isCompact_Icc
    filter_upwards [hK.compl_mem_cocompact] with x hx
    rw [dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos x.property.1]
    exact not_le.mp hx

/-- The constructed value is the coordinate itself, not a selected witness. -/
@[simp]
theorem iocCoordinate_apply (b : ℝ) (x : Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) b) :
    iocCoordinate b x = ((x : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  rfl

/-- The coordinate's actual cocompact vanishing law. -/
theorem iocCoordinate_zero_at_infty (b : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun x : Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) b => ((x : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (cocompact (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) b)) (nhds 0) :=
  zero_at_infty (iocCoordinate b)

/-- The stock C0 supremum norm equals the nonnegative endpoint. -/
@[simp]
theorem norm_iocCoordinate (b : ℝ) : ‖iocCoordinate b‖ = max b 0 := by
  have hupper : ‖iocCoordinate b‖ ≤ max b 0 := by
    rw [← norm_toBCF_eq_norm]
    apply (BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_le (le_max_right b 0)).2
    intro x
    change ‖((x : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤ max b 0
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos x.property.1]
    exact x.property.2.trans (le_max_left b 0)
  apply le_antisymm hupper
  by_cases hb : 0 < b
  · have hlower := (iocCoordinate b).toBCF.norm_coe_le_norm
      (⟨b, ⟨hb, le_rfl⟩⟩ : Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) b)
    change ‖(b : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖iocCoordinate b‖ at hlower
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hb] at hlower
    simpa only [max_eq_left hb.le] using hlower
  · have hnonpos : b ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt hb
    let : IsEmpty (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) b) :=
      ⟨fun x => (not_lt_of_ge hnonpos)
        (lt_of_lt_of_le x.property.1 x.property.2)⟩
    have hzero : iocCoordinate b = 0 := eq_of_empty _ _
    simpa only [hzero, norm_zero, max_eq_right hnonpos] using
      (le_rfl : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 0)

/-- A local square-root coordinate gives actual algebraic positivity.
No extra public square-root factory or supplied positive witness is needed. -/
theorem iocCoordinate_eq_star_mul_self (b : ℝ) :
    ∃ g : C₀(Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) b, ℂ), iocCoordinate b = star g * g := by
  have hreal :
      Tendsto (fun x : Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) b => (x : ℝ))
        (cocompact (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) b)) (nhds 0) :=
    Filter.tendsto_ofReal_iff.mp (iocCoordinate_zero_at_infty b)
  let g : C₀(Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) b, ℂ) :=
    { toFun := fun x => (Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) : ℂ)
      continuous_toFun := Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
        (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp continuous_subtype_val)
      zero_at_infty' := by
        have hs := (Real.continuous_sqrt.tendsto 0).comp hreal
        have hc := (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto (Real.sqrt 0)).comp hs
        simpa only [Function.comp_def, Real.sqrt_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero] using hc }
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  ext x
  change ((x : ℝ) : ℂ) =
    star (Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) : ℂ)
  rw [show star (Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) : ℂ) = (Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) : ℂ) by simp,
    ← Complex.ofReal_mul]
  exact congrArg (fun r : ℝ => (r : ℂ))
    (Real.mul_self_sqrt x.property.1.le).symm

end ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap

module

public import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.ZeroAtInftyUnitization
public import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.Compact
public import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.SecondCountableSpace
public import MathlibExt.Topology.Compactification.OnePoint.SecondCountable
public import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.Isometry

import Mathlib.Topology.UniformSpace.Cauchy

/-!
# Separability of continuous functions vanishing at infinity

The stock zero extension to OnePoint is isometric for the existing uniform
pseudometric. Consequently C₀(X,E) is separable for locally compact Hausdorff
second-countable X and a separable pseudometric coefficient space with zero.
The norm formula specializes this same map to normed additive groups.
No algebra, coefficient unit, or completeness hypothesis is needed.
-/

@[expose] public section

open TopologicalSpace
open scoped ZeroAtInfty

universe uX uE

namespace ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap

variable {X : Type uX} {E : Type uE} [TopologicalSpace X] [R1Space X]

/-- The stock zero extension preserves the uniform distance, even for an
empty domain or a pseudometric coefficient space. -/
theorem isometry_toOnePoint [PseudoMetricSpace E] [Zero E] :
    Isometry (toOnePoint : C₀(X, E) → C(OnePoint X, E)) := by
  apply Isometry.of_dist_eq
  intro f g
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (ContinuousMap.dist_le (dist_nonneg : 0 ≤ dist f g)).2
    intro x
    induction x using OnePoint.rec with
    | infty =>
        simpa only [toOnePoint_infty, dist_self] using (dist_nonneg : 0 ≤ dist f g)
    | coe x =>
        simpa only [toOnePoint_coe, toBCF_apply, dist_toBCF_eq_dist] using
          (BoundedContinuousFunction.dist_coe_le_dist (f := f.toBCF) (g := g.toBCF) x)
  · change dist f.toBCF g.toBCF ≤ dist f.toOnePoint g.toOnePoint
    apply (BoundedContinuousFunction.dist_le (dist_nonneg : 0 ≤ dist f.toOnePoint g.toOnePoint)).2
    intro x
    simpa only [toOnePoint_coe, toBCF_apply] using
      (ContinuousMap.dist_apply_le_dist (f := f.toOnePoint) (g := g.toOnePoint)
        (x : OnePoint X))

/-- Extending a function vanishing at infinity by zero preserves its
actual stock supremum norm, including an empty original domain. -/
theorem norm_toOnePoint [NormedAddCommGroup E] (f : C₀(X, E)) :
    ‖f.toOnePoint‖ = ‖f‖ := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ (norm_nonneg f)).2
    intro x
    induction x using OnePoint.rec with
    | infty => simpa only [toOnePoint_infty, norm_zero] using norm_nonneg f
    | coe x =>
        simpa only [toOnePoint_coe, toBCF_apply, norm_toBCF_eq_norm]
            using f.toBCF.norm_coe_le_norm x
  · change ‖f.toBCF‖ ≤ ‖f.toOnePoint‖
    apply (BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_le (norm_nonneg _)).2
    intro x
    simpa only [toOnePoint_coe, toBCF_apply] using f.toOnePoint.norm_coe_le_norm (x : OnePoint X)

end ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap

namespace ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap

/-- Actual C₀(X,E), with its uniform pseudometric topology, is separable for
a locally compact Hausdorff second-countable domain and a separable
pseudometric coefficient space with zero. -/
theorem separableSpace (X : Type uX) (E : Type uE) [TopologicalSpace X]
    [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X]
    [PseudoMetricSpace E] [Zero E] [SeparableSpace E] : SeparableSpace C₀(X, E) := by
  let : SecondCountableTopology (OnePoint X) := OnePoint.secondCountableTopology X
  let : SecondCountableTopology E := UniformSpace.secondCountable_of_separable E
  let : SecondCountableTopology C₀(X, E) :=
    (isometry_toOnePoint (X := X) (E := E)).isUniformInducing.isInducing.secondCountableTopology
  infer_instance

end ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap
